facts.label: Reagent bags
facts.value: A new bag slot takes only reagent bags. Tailors make a 6-slot Linen Reagent Bag and later Woolen and Mageweave Reagent Bags.

facts.label: Bigger bags
facts.value: Red Linen Bag is now 8 slots, Mooncloth Bag 18, Bottomless Bag 20 and the Warlock Felcloth soul bag 32. Mageweave (12) and Runecloth (14) bags are unchanged.

facts.label: Dyes in recipes
facts.value: The Runecloth Bag now needs 4 Magenta Dye and 2 Cerulean Dye, which alchemists make.

facts.label: Gear only you can make
facts.value: Some crafts are Bind on Pickup for the tailor, such as Novice Ardent's Sash and Filigreed Flame Circlet.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: Faction Banner at skill 20, Spinning Wheel at 140 (blueprint from the Unstable Sentinel in Dalaran) and Loom at 300.

facts.label: Skill ranks
facts.value: Apprentice up to 75, Journeyman up to 150 (skill 50, level 10), Expert up to 225 (skill 125, level 20) and Artisan up to 300 (skill 200, level 35). 300 is the cap.

facts.label: Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Favor recipes come from the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge, paid with Merchant's Favor from sealed Waylaid Crates.

facts.label: Legacy
facts.value: The first time you reach 150, 225 and 300 in a craft you earn 1 Legacy point each. Dedicated Study gives a daily skill-up.

facts.label: Spell-school sets
facts.value: The Azeroth Commerce Authority sells recipes for spell-school cloth sets for Merchant's Favor.

facts.label: Faction Banner
facts.value: The Banner's buff matches Divine Spirit, works only for your own faction and does not stack with the Priest buff.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: The final list of Favor cloth sets and their prices.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether the slightly shorter Mooncloth cooldown seen in beta data is in the live game.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether Tailoring gets embroidery; it appears only in unverified perk lists.

facts.label: Professions window
facts.value: Professions have their own window, opened with K. Recipe lists can be searched and filtered, and you can track a recipe in the objectives frame.

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones. You sit at the camp for at least 1 minute to get them.

facts.label: Campsite size
facts.value: A basic campsite holds 3 camp features, one per player. Cooking upgrades raise this to 5 or 10.

facts.label: Earning Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Fill Waylaid Crates (found in the world or bought on the Auction House) and hand the sealed crates to Marcy Baker of the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge. Craftsman's Writs add reputation.

facts.label: Profession title
facts.value: Crafters who reach 300 can earn a certification item that unlocks a profession title. Alliance players get it from the Azeroth Commerce Authority.

facts.label: Vendor prices
facts.value: Blizzard's beta notes say many profession-made items sell to vendors for less.
facts.gameBuild: WoW: Forever (Blizzard beta notes of 16 Oct 2026)
